text: Meanwhile, in 660 BC, the islands were home to hunters and fishermen, and rice was only just arriving from the mainland.
spoken: Meanwhile, in six hundred and sixty B.C., the islands were home to hunters and fishermen, and rice was only just arriving from the mainland.
